Subject: Delivered: Therabiotech RFI — export controls & DPA annex (draft)

Lena / Therabiotech team —

Thanks for the RFI and patience. Attached are the materials requested: 
- Therabiotech_RFI_v2_completed.xlsx (our completed matrix with line-by-line answers)
- DPA_annex_draft.docx (Redwood's proposed DPA annex with redlines and comments)
- transfer-mapping.csv (region/service/data-class mapping)
- operational-evidence.zip (KMS model, rotation cadence sample, audit-log-schema.txt, sanitized log sample)

High-level summary of key items: 
- Cross-border transfers: Redwood operates with region-aware routing. EU-originated personal data is by default processed in EU regions when you select EU tenancy; for hosted customers we provide EU-region model endpoints and a documented routing policy. Where EU-origin data is processed outside the EU (rare fallback), we commit SCCs + documented subprocessors + 24/7 incident escalation. (See transfer-mapping.csv for current topology.)

- DPF equivalence: Redwood currently maps to the majority of DPF items. For the few items where a binding EU-residency guarantee is requested, we propose three options: 1) Dedicated VPC-based deployment (Private) for scoped processing; 2) SCCs + contractual attestation + quarterly transfer reports; 3) Limited data egress controls with agreed retention rules and redaction at rest. We've annotated the DPF column in the spreadsheet with proposed compensating controls.

- KMS & key management: We use customer-specific CMKs (where customers opt in) stored in region-specific KMS/HSMs. Included: key rotation cadence (example last-12), key separation diagram, and an explanation of how we limit key scope to processing pipelines. For customers requiring extra isolation, we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) under Private deployments.

- Audit logging & retention: Attached schema lists required fields (timestamp, request id, model id, route id, user token hash, operation type). Retention baseline is 90 days for request-level traces for hosted tiers; extended retention available via Dedicated/Private plans. Logs can be exported to your audit endpoint on request (SFTP or cloud bucket) subject to contractual terms.

Next steps: please review the attached draft annex and the completed spreadsheet. Kimberly is available to discuss contract wording; Ben can walk through the operational evidence. If you prefer a call, I propose Tue May 7 14:00 CEST (Jonas/Kim/Ben available).

We flagged two clauses in the annex where legal may want small edits (liability cap carve-outs for data breaches and request for explicit SCC text insertion). We've also highlighted a recommended clause to support DPF posture (quarterly transfer reports + optional dedicated tenancy).

Please confirm receipt and the best time for a short walk-through.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
